Akhaṇḍatvanirūpaṇa
adv. TA. 1406/3.

Akhaṇḍadīpodyāpanavidhi
or kRttikAkhaNDadI. udyA. v.. dh. MD. 8166.

Akhaṇḍadhāman
pupil of Akhaṇḍānubhūti.
If this Akhaṇḍānubhūti is the same a. the preceptor of Akhaṇḍānanda (Vivaraṇatattvadīpana), the date of Akhaṇḍadhāman will be the same a. that of Akhaṇḍānanda.
--Upadeśasāhasrīvyākhyā. MT. 2793.
--Mahābhārata mokṣadharma-vyākhyātātparyaprakāśikā. Trav. Uni. 575.

Akhaṇḍamālāgāyatrīvidhi
mantra. Bharatpur I. 200.

Akhaṇḍayogīndra
mentioned by Maheśvarānanda Sarasvatī in the invocatory stanzas in [Page016-a. his Jñānopadeśasāra (Hz. 1026). Hz. III. p. 91.

Akhaṇḍarahasya
name of C. by Haṁsayogin on Ārṣagītā, taken for the most part from the Rāmāyaṇa. TCD. 266.

Akhaṇḍaviṣaya
adv. deals with the Akhaṇḍārthaprakriyā. Oppert II. 4439.

Akhaṇḍasvarūpavāda
ny. by Śiṅgarācārya. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 1.

Akhaṇḍātmadīpikā
adv. Oppert II. 4440.

Akhaṇḍātmaprakāśa
adv. Rice 128. Same a. the next ?

Akhaṇḍātmaprakāśa(-śikā)
adv. by Gopālānanda Sarasvatī, pupil of Yogānanda. MT. 3891 (a.. Mysore I. p.. 420 (2 mss.). 656 (1 ms.).

Akhaṇḍādarśa
dh. Q. by Hārita Veṅkaṭācārya in his Smṛtiratnākara an. other works an. by Vaidyanātha Dīkṣita in his Smṛtimuktāphala.
Kane suggests Akhaṇḍa a. author, HDS. I. p.. 507a an. 678a. MD. VI. p.. 2415-16 takes the work a. Vyavahārakāṇḍa an. the a. a. Akhaṇḍādarśa.
Col. here: ityakhaNDAdarzIye vyavahArakANDaH |
Beginning here: dharmakANDazcintitaH pUrvamakhaNDena | athAtra(trA)khaNDena vyavahAraH kriyate |
Mysore I. p. 93 has 3 mss. of this work, one of which is called Akhaṇḍānandīya suggesting thereby Akhaṇḍānanda a. the a. The work is q. a. Akhaṇḍādarśa an. the a. is cited a. Akhaṇḍādarśakāra. See Smṛtimuktāphala I, Gharpure's Ed.. p. 186. See below under Akhaṇḍānandīya also.
Adyar 20-D-82 (not noticed in the catalogue). This ms. has the first Maṅgalaśloka given below from the Mysore ms. an. then gives a text containing [Page016-b] only the quoted verses without the author's remarks. MD. 3207. Mysore 1. p. 93 (3 mss.). Taylor III. 742 (A. ādarśīya) (with Ṭīkā).
All these mss. contain only the Vyavahārakāṇḍa.
The following beginning an. col. are from a Mysore ms.
Beg.: yogihRtpadmanilayaM layasargAvanezvaram | hariM haritapatrAbhaM vande vandyaM surotkaraiH || dharmakANDasthitaH pUrvamakhaNDenANDamaNDakaH | vyavahArakANDaH kriyate mayA paNDitasaMmataH ||
Col.: ityakhaNDAdarzIye vyavahArakANDe prakIrNakam |

Akhaṇḍānanda(rāmāyaṇavicāra)
name of work; a. a.. disquisition on Rāma a. the only Supreme Being denoted by the word Brahman. There is also a. a.. gloss on the text; possibly text an. gloss are both by the same a. Mysore I. p. 146.

Akhaṇḍānanda
adv. writer; pupil of Akhaṇḍānubhūti.
--Pañcapādikāvivaraṇatattvadīpana.
In the intro. verses in his Tattvadīpana, Akhaṇḍānanda salutes Ānandagiri in two verses, an. again in one verse a. the beginning of the fifth Varṇaka, a. Bodhapṛthvīdhara, Ānandaśaila an. Bodhaśaila an. refers to ‘Ratnācala’ a. Ānandagiri's birthplace.
Ānandagiri (also Ānandajñānagiri) is assigned to the latter half of the 13th cent.

Akhaṇḍānanda
--Mantroddhāraprakaraṇa. NW. 186. Sūcīpattra 42. Śṛṅgerī Mutt 223 (i).
--Mahāviṣṇupūjāpaddhati. NW. 186.
--Muktisopānatantra. Ben. 41. RASB. VIII. A. 6386 (only the Siddhakhaṇḍa [Page017-a. dealing with the worship of Chinnamastā).
Nothing is known of the Akhaṇḍānanda or Akhaṇḍānandas who wrote these works. Kane, HDS. I. p. 678a, takes Akh., a. of the Mahāviṣnupūjāpaddhati, a. being identical with the a. of the Tattvadīpana, the pupil of Akhaṇḍānubhūti; no evidence.

Akhaṇḍānanda
--Saundaryalaharīṭīkā--Kaivalyavardhanī. Adyar I. p. 178a. The identity of this Akhaṇḍānanda is not known. The ms. bears the date A. D. 1725.

Akhaṇḍānandavarṇin
--Haricarita. Section 42 of its first part contains a Puruṣottamakavaca, which was ptd. from Bombay in 1896.
--Puruṣottamakavaca.
Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 23 an. 83.

Akhaṇḍānandaśivayogin
--Bhairavasahasranāmāvalistotra. Trav. Uni. 2424B.

Akhaṇḍānandasarasvatī
teacher of Kṛṣṇānandayati, a. of Brahmatattvasubodhinī. MD. 15493. 16072. MT. 1784 (a..

Akhaṇḍānandasarasvatī
or akha. yati different from the a. of the Tattvadīpana, the pupil of Akhaṇḍānubhūti; was the pupil of Svayamprakāśa Sarasvatī; a. a householder had the name Raṅganātha; belonged to the Nalagantu family an. was the son of Kālahastiyajvan (Advaita ratnakośavyāº an. Bhedadhikkāravivṛti) an. Yajñāmbikā; then became a Sannyāsin; was patronised by Immaḍi Jagadekarāya, A. D. 1540-90, chief of Chennapatna in Mysore an. a subordinate of Aliya Rāmarāja, Tirumala, [Page017-b] Śrī Raṅga an. Veṅkaṭarāya of Vijayanagar.
--Advaiṭaratnakośa (Nṛsiṁhāśramin) vyākhyā-Bhāvaprakāśikā. Mysore I. p. 432. Rice 166. Śṛṅgerī Mutt 47. 48 (called here Dīpikā) an. mentioned also in the a.'s Bhāmatīvyāº, p. 944, Vol. II, Cal. Skt. Ser. edn. This is different from the same a.'s father's Advaitaratnakośabhāvaprakāśikā, for which see Adyar II. p. 142a an. Mysore I. p. 432.
--Tarkabhāṣāprakāśa, a C. on Keśavamiśra's T. bhāṣā. MD. 4121-3. Mysore I. p. 387 (2 mss.).
--Tarkabhāṣātattvabodhinīvyākhyā, a C.. on Gaṇeśa Dīkṣita's Tattvabodhinī on Keśavamiśra's T. bhāṣā. Mysore I. p. 389 (2 mss.). Auf. I. p. 1b refers to Taylor I. 26 for a. Tarkabhāṣāprakāśavyāº by: Akhaṇḍānanda an. p. 225b, Auf. gives it a. a super-gloss on Govardhana's C. on the Tarkabhāṣā. Taylor has: “Tarkabhāṣyavyākhyānam, a prose C. on a. ancient work entitled Tarkabhāṣya. By Akhaṇḍānandayati.” Both statements wrong. Ms. in Taylor really the direct C. of Akhaṇḍānanda on the T. bhāṣā.
--Nyāyasiddhāntadīpa (Śaśadhara) vyākhyā-Candrikā. Mysore I. p.. 392-3 (2 mss.).
--Bhāmatīṛjuprakāśikā (pub. in the Cal. Skt. Ser. edn. of the Br. sūtras with nine C.s by Mm. Anantakrishna Sastri). Adyar II. p. 136b. Mysore I. p. 440. Rice 170 (Vācaspatyavyāº, by Raṅganātha).
Akhaṇḍānandīya, ny., Gough p. 175, Mysore 4. 5 must be one of the Nyāya works of Akhaṇḍānanda noted above. [Page018-a.

Akhaṇḍānandīya
dh. Mysore I. p. 93; same a. the Akhaṇḍādarśa, for which see above.

Akhaṇḍānubhūti
teacher of Akhaṇḍadhāman (C. on the Upadeśasāhasrī). MT. 2793, an. also of Akhaṇḍānanda (Vivaraṇatattvadīpana), latter half of the 13th century. Hall p. 90. IO. p. 726a. Weber 622.

Akhaṇḍārtha_Savyākhya
adv. Baroda 11430.

Akhaṇḍārthatvabhaṅga
viś. adv. by Dharmapurīśa of Ātreya gotra. Different from the third section of Doḍḍayācārya's Advaitavidyāvijaya (MD. Vol. X. p. 3640).
Adyar II. p. 153b. Adyar D. X. 78 (extracts, p. 200).

Akhaṇḍārthatvalakṣaṇakhaṇḍana
dvai. by Veṅkaṭeśa Nṛsiṁhācārya. Mysore I. p.. 503. 663.

Akhaṇḍārthanirūpaṇa
adv. Ānandāśrama 530. Oppert I. 1729.

Akhaṇḍārthavāda
adv. Up. Br. Mutt 276.

Akhaṇḍaikarasavākyārtha
adv. prakaraṇa, ascribed to Śaṅkara. Adyar II. p. 138. Adyar D. IX. 542.

Akhaṇḍaikādaśīvratakalpa
vratakalpa. said to form ch. 12 of the Mārgaśīrṣamāhātmya of the Skāndapurāṇa. MT. 1435 (l).
--C.. 35 of the Padmapurāṇa. MT. 1435 (m). TD. 14204-207 (4 mss.).

Akhayarāja
--Pratimāsānta-caturdaśī-vratodyāpana. in Skt. Dig. Jain.
See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XIII. i. p. 38.
